title: The Ice Emperor
summary: The map-shop owner is Hai Bodong, the Ice Emperor, once one of the Top Ten of the Jia Ma Empire. He once fought the former Misty Cloud Sect leader and beat two Dou Huangs at the Convention for the Strong, and Yao Lao sees that his Dou Huang strength is suppressed to Dou Ling. Xiao Yan fights him for the map fragment through Condensed Ice Mirror, an ice cave and Mysterious Ice Killing Vortex, and with Yao Lao's Soul Power and a snow-white flame he traps Hai Bodong in ice. Hai Bodong explains that Queen Medusa of the Snakemen defeated him and sealed him at Dou Ling with her Curse of the Snakes Seal. He offers the other map fragment and a Dou Huang's favour if Xiao Yan refines a six-tier Spiritual Recovery Purple Pill. He also needs Sand's Datura from Snakemen land, which he cannot enter because Medusa would sense him. In return he promises his research on where the Heavenly Flame is in the Tager Desert, and Xiao Yan agrees.
events: Narration: the Ice Emperor's history as one of the Jia Ma Empire's Top Ten.
Yao Lao sees the man is a Dou Huang suppressed to Dou Ling.
Xiao Yan fights him for the map fragment; ice mist, Condensed Ice Mirror and an ice cave.
Yao Lao lends Soul Power; a snow-white flame traps the old man in ice.
He names himself Hai Bodong, the Ice Emperor, sealed by Queen Medusa's Curse of the Snakes Seal.
He asks for a six-tier Spiritual Recovery Purple Pill and Sand's Datura from Snakemen territory.
In return he offers the second map fragment, a favour and his Heavenly Flame research; Xiao Yan agrees.
introduced: Top Ten of the Jia Ma Empire
cultivation: Hai Bodong is a Dou Huang sealed at the Dou Ling level. Xiao Yan calls himself a two-tier alchemist.
